policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Match a layout using the goal, bin, and visible cube arrangement together, never bin proximity alone.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Match a layout using the requested quantities and colors, bin, and visible cube arrangement together, never bin proximity alone. When several preferences have the same goal and nearby bins, a single nearby cube is not sufficient to choose between them if other observable arrangement evidence distinguishes them; use that evidence jointly. Do not transfer an indexed target or color order from a different arrangement.
